note: The main banks: Aruba Bank, Caribbean Mercantile Bank (CMB, of the Maduro & Curiel's group) and RBC Royal Bank, Aruba's largest retail banks. RBC Royal Bank's Aruba credit cards page (rendered 30 October 2026): its personal RBC Rewards Visa Platinum, Visa Gold and Visa Classic International, in US dollars, each with its annual fee and its 18% purchase and cash advance rates; its business cards aren't written, and the page states no other fee. Caribbean Mercantile Bank's bankcard services fees page (read 30 October 2026): its personal Visa Classic, Visa AA, Visa Platinum, MasterCard Classic and MasterCard Black Personal, in US dollars, and its Florin Card Cash Back, Efectivo and AAdvantage, in Aruban florins, each with its annual membership fee (none on the Efectivo), its yearly interest (18%; 16% on the Efectivo; the page also gives each as a monthly 1.5% or 1.3%), its over limit and late fees, and a cash advance fee of 3% (at least 10 dollars or florins). The optional fraud fee and balance protection, the replacement fee and the corporate cards aren't written; the page states no minimum payment, foreign transaction fee or penalty rate. Aruba Bank's credit card pages and its fees page (read 30 October 2026) publish no interest rate or card fee, so its ArubaCard and other cards aren't written. This file kept RBC's Visa Classic International, read on 29 October 2026. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) looked for more banks and added none: Aruba Bank's fee page and card pages give no credit card rate or fee (only cashback and credit limits). No minimum payment is published for Caribbean Mercantile Bank's and RBC's cards; tried (wave 5, 30 October 2026): every document this file cites, downloaded again on 30 October 2026 and searched for a minimum payment, states none for them; RBC's Caribbean credit card pages for the country state no minimum payment; no web search was made for them in this wave, the searches shared by every agent having gone to the larger countries; archive.org's availability API names no snapshot of the 2 documents this file cites.
